The regex accepts MLP tensors from any numeric layer, rather than restricting layers to `0..15`; checking only `merged == 64` could therefore merge the wrong 64 tensors and skip required ones, violating Required Result 2. Additionally, required “fail loudly” checks use `assert`, which Python disables under optimization (`python -O`).
